Sentence (English): I struggled with dishwashing being the most tedious and time-consuming chore in the kitchen, so I finally took the plunge and bought a MyDear 6-place setting dishwasher.
Comments (English): I struggled with dishwashing being the most tedious and time-consuming chore in the kitchen, so I finally took the plunge and bought a MyDear 6-place setting dishwasher. To start with the conclusion, my quality of life has completely changed—to the point where I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner! First off, the clean and bright white design doesn't detract from the kitchen decor, making the space look much more sophisticated. Being a 6-place setting, it is neither too big nor too small, making it the perfect size to place on the kitchen counter. The interior space is also efficiently organized, allowing for ample storage of dishes, pots, and cups accumulated throughout the day. What I was most satisfied with was the on-site installation service. The technician visited right on time and installed everything—from drilling holes in the sink to connecting wiring—quickly and neatly without any wobbling. They also kindly explained the usage instructions and precautions, so even someone like me who isn't good with machines could use it right away. When I actually ran it, the high-temperature washing removed grease and sauce residue completely, leaving everything squeaky clean. Since it also sterilizes, I felt it was much more hygienic than washing by hand. The noise level is also lower than I expected, so I don't feel burdened even when running it late at night. I am truly happy that the stressful times of looking at piles of dishes after work are gone, and I now have some genuine free time. I highly recommend this to anyone looking for a dishwasher that offers reliable performance without taking up much kitchen space!

Sentence (English): I bought this product this month at MediaMarkt, and after the technicians installed the dishwasher, I took it out to install the remaining parts: the felt pad for the bottom, the black strips for the bottom, and the strips for the side cabinet.
Comments (English): [ Factory defects and lack of quality control ] || ---------------- || I bought this product this month at MediaMarkt, and after the technicians installed the dishwasher, I took it out to install the remaining parts: the felt pad for the bottom, the black strips for the bottom, and the strips for the side cabinet. To my surprise, when I took it out, I saw that the dishwasher had several defects. Four screws were missing from the back to secure the side panels (holes had already been drilled), and the lower side panels had broken plastic parts that vibrated with the slightest touch. Despite all this, I tried to fix it myself because I urgently needed a working dishwasher. I inserted four computer screws into each of the factory-installed holes on the back and added anti-vibration rubber to the lower side panels to prevent them from vibrating. I'm using the dishwasher and it works very well, to be honest, everything comes out sparkling clean, but my first impression of this product has already been bad. On the very first day, I had these problems due to quality control issues. These details could lead me to return this appliance in a few days or request a replacement.
Comments (Original): [ Desperfectos de fábrica y falta control de calidad ] || ---------------- || He comprado este producto este mes en MediaMarkt y tras que los técnicos colocasen el lavavajillas, lo saque de su sitio para ponerle las cosas que faltaban por instalar: el fieltro que va en la parte inferior, las tiras negras que van en la parte inferior y las tiras al armario lateral. Cual fue mi sorpresa que al sacarlo, vi que el lavavajillas tenía unas serie de desperfectos como que le faltaban 4 tornillos en la parte trasera para sujetar las chapas laterales (ya había orificios) y que en las partes inferiores laterales, había plásticos rotos y las chapas laterales vibraban con solo tocarlas. A pesar de todo esto, he intentado solucionarlo por mi cuenta por la urgencia de tener un lavavajillas funcionando, poniéndole 4 tornillos de ordenador en cada uno de los orificios que tiene de fábrica en la parte trasera y goma antivibración en las zonas laterales inferiores para que no vibrasen las chapas. Estoy usando el lavavajillas y funciona muy bien la verdad sea dicha, sale todo limpísimo, pero la primera impresión de este producto ya ha sido mala, el primer día ya tenía estos problemas por faltas en el control de calidad, estos detalles pueden hacer que este dispositivo sea devuelto por mi parte en unos días o solicitar la sustitución por uno nuevo.

Comments (English): [ Most quiet dishwasher I have ever owned! ] || ---------------- || I bought a 500 series Bosch dishwasher to replace one tht died. I needed to call the Bosch 800 number to get the Home Connect app to connect to the dishwasher but with their help all is well. The app allows for almost unlimited choices in how I want to program the dishwasher. I like that I can lift the upper basket up or down depending on the size of items in the lower basket. I also like the upper silverware tray so I can remove the silverware basket from the lower tray an reclaim that space for dishes. I have only used the dishwasher once and some of the dishes weren't completely dry. But I have increased the drying time in the app so I hope that solves the problem.

Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. The product was delivered on the date I requested. Since we are a two-person household, I chose the 6-place setting model. As mentioned in the product comments, it doesn't hold as many dishes as I expected, so I needed a knack for loading them into the dishwasher. Having a dishwasher doesn't mean hand washing is completely eliminated. Large pots, cutting boards, and trays that are difficult to fit in the dishwasher still require hand washing as needed. I am satisfied because the dishwasher works hard to clean everything thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing was also useful. Detergent stains were left on the dishes, so I plan to try switching to a dishwasher-specific detergent next time. The product's display and button controls are intuitive and easy to use. In any case, installing the dishwasher was a very good choice.

Sentence (English): Bought new and it is a good machine, has run well- but i only run it once or twice a wk.
Comments (English): [ LG LDFC2423B 2024 model ] || ---------------- || Bought new and it is a good machine, has run well- but i only run it once or twice a wk. Drawback is front panel only lights up when: power 1st turned on & have to use flashlight to do settings! It lights up when on & end of cycle. * Other drawback; no matter what setting (even xtra dry), interior still has alot of water drops all inside- i even make sure glasses, etc are inserted at angle to not retain H2o. Have to wipe a lot & keep slightly open to rid the steam- still have to wipe interior inc door & water blades! My old USA American dishwasher was bone dry at cycle end. (fan? ) It is fairly quiet however. And after 2 years, i just figured out i can cycle it for 1 he, shorten wash time. Other than water retention, my complaint would be detergent 'door' which began to get truck to close at about 6 months. It will close, but latch is worn'? Maybe its the plastic that warps over time. Overall good enough but if you wash daily, i suggest getting more heavy duty machine with a 'Dry' cycle.

Sentence (English): It feels like dishwashing never ends in a household with children.
Comments (English): It feels like dishwashing never ends in a household with children. From cups and snack plates to straw cups and lunch boxes, it used to feel like I was doing nothing but washing dishes all day long, but getting the LG DIOS Objet Collection dishwasher has completely changed my quality of life! First of all, what I was most satisfied with was the cleaning power. I was surprised that greasy plates that held my child's side dishes and dishes stained with curry were cleaned much more thoroughly than I expected. I especially liked that, perhaps due to the TrueSteam function, there were fewer water stains, and I felt much more at ease cleaning baby bottles and children's tableware. Also, the hardest part of parenting is evening dishwashing. I used to feel completely drained seeing the mountain of dishes piled up after putting the kids to sleep, but now that I just have to put them in and press a button, that time has turned into a time for complete relaxation. That was truly the biggest change. It holds more storage than I expected, so I can organize pots and pans all at once, and the adjustable shelf height makes it convenient to store children's water bottles or small dishes. Above all, the design is so beautiful. It features the clean design characteristic of the Objet Collection, so it doesn't detract from the kitchen atmosphere; instead, it blends in well like interior decor. Even friends who come over always ask what brand the dishwasher is. At first, I wondered if a dishwasher was really necessary, but now it is the appliance I am most satisfied with among all my parenting appliances. I honestly wonder why I didn't buy it sooner... I highly recommend it, especially to households raising children that want to reduce dishwashing stress for even a single day!

Comments (English): [ Kitchenaid Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Our prior Kitchenaid lasted 22 years and was still working but started to get loud. We studied dishwashers and reviews in depth and selected this one. Delivery and installation was superb (5 star). The machine itself is not perfect. Sentence (English): This dishwasher cost $999 plus tax and installation.
Comments (English): [ Low Quality, False Advertising ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher cost $999 plus tax and installation. Total came to almost $1400. First of all, it is supposed to dry the dishes. This is a totally false claim and should be removed from their ads. It does almost the same job drying as my 11 year old Maytag. I have tried regular dry and pro dry as well as letting dishes sit for hours after door has popped open. The dishes are still wet with pools of water sitting at the tops of cups with even the SLIGHTEST concave. Everything is wet! It has a VERY CHEAP thin feel. Doors feel like aluminum. Very light and thin. The lower rack does not slide in and out smoothly. Wheels frequently go off the track. Third rack is USELESS. Do not believe ads it does not fit coffee cups or glasses unless they are child sized! My 16 OZ cups dont fit neither do any of my coffee mugs! Only good for spatulas and baby things if you have a child, which I dont. I found out, albeit too late, from locals who work on these that they only last 3 to 4 years, and Kitchen Aid is the dishwasher most frequently replaced as they no longer are built to the quality standards they used to be. Repairs are also frequent.I dicovered, again, too late, that LG is the brand to buy at present for reliability and longevity. Kitchen Aide is done. The control panels cause a lot of problems. Repairs can start after a few months, even a few weeks. I can only hope that I got a good unit and it will last me a few years. But so far it has not lived up to its reputation at all.Bottom line, I thought by spending more I would get a quality product. I was foolish and regret my decision. I cannot afford to replace this in a few years and hope it will last through my 5 year warranty. I read nightmare reviews about repairs taking months.

Sentence (English): After using it myself, the most satisfying aspect was saving dishwashing time.
Comments (English): [ Samsung Dishwasher Review: My dishwashing stress has drastically decreased! ] || ---------------- || After using it myself, the most satisfying aspect was saving dishwashing time. Since I just put the used dishes in after a meal and press a button, the burden of housework has definitely decreased. It was really convenient as it cleaned even greasy frying pans and pots thoroughly, significantly reducing the frequency of hand washing. Also, the operating noise is not loud, so I could use it without any disturbance during dinner time or while my child was sleeping. The exterior is neat and stylish, so it does not detract from the kitchen atmosphere and actually gives it a more organized feel. The drying performance is also decent; most cups and plates could be stored immediately without any water, and while stainless steel tableware sometimes had a few water droplets remaining, I was satisfied overall. The only downside is that space utilization varies depending on how large pots or frying pans are stacked. However, after using it a few times, I quickly got the hang of it, so it wasn't a major inconvenience.

Sentence (English): This is an honest review of the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher, which I bought with my own money and which has skyrocketed my quality of life lately—to the point where I wonder how I ever managed without one!
Comments (English): [ Thanks to the ultimate value-for-money large-capacity dishwasher, I'm freed from washing dishes! ] || ---------------- || This is an honest review of the My Dear 12-place setting dishwasher, which I bought with my own money and which has skyrocketed my quality of life lately—to the point where I wonder how I ever managed without one! Washing dishes might seem like a trivial task, but they pile up like mountains after just one meal. Especially if you cook greasy food, soaking and scrubbing them in hot water completely drains your energy. I debated for months, but when I saw a listing on Coupang at such a great price, I finally decided to bite the bullet and buy it. To start with the conclusion, I am extremely satisfied. Let me begin by talking about the installation process. Since it was Rocket Installation, the technician arrived the very next day after I requested it. I was worried that the installation might be tricky because my house is an older building. However, the technician was incredibly kind, checked the placement, and meticulously verified everything, including the drain pipe connection. I was concerned about potential leaks after installation, but seeing him take full responsibility and look after everything until the very end gave me complete confidence. In terms of performance, it exceeded my expectations as well. Being a 12-place setting model, the interior is definitely spacious. Large pots, pans, and bulky salad bowls fit right in. Perhaps because the water jets from both the top and bottom are powerful, even if I put items in after a quick pre-wash, they come out squeaky clean, free of chili powder or grease. Most importantly, I was worried that plastic containers might deform, but I was relieved to see them cleaned perfectly without any warping, likely because the temperature was just right. It seems like a product designed very cleverly for space utilization. There is a multi-purpose basket at the very top, allowing me to spread out spoons, chopsticks, and cooking utensils without them overlapping; it feels much more hygienic and cleaner than simply keeping them in a cutlery holder. On days with less dishes, there is a feature to select and run only the top or bottom sections, which is efficient in terms of saving electricity and water. The design is sleek and clean in a white tone, making the kitchen atmosphere much brighter. Previously, a drying rack occupied a large space on the sink, leaving little room to cook, but now that everything fits inside the dishwasher, it has a magical effect of making the kitchen look more spacious. Of course, there may be slight differences in drying performance compared to expensive, high-end models. Sometimes, if you try to take the dishes out immediately after washing, there is a little moisture left. However, since this naturally resolves if you leave the door slightly ajar after the cycle finishes or let it sit for a while, it didn't feel like a major drawback to me. Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. I have used only LG appliances for 15 years since getting married, believing that LG is the way to go for home appliances. However, since people said Samsung was a perfect match for the finishing materials I chose for my recent interior renovation, I decided to purchase a Samsung appliance for the first time. The price was quite attractive, and I really liked the minimalist design and the overall appearance. Needless to say, it blends seamlessly with the surrounding appliances and furniture. On the scheduled date, the assigned technician visited first to check the installation environment and fixed any issues. They were incredibly kind; even though I had to slightly trim the baseboard, they worked outside and cleaned up perfectly before leaving. The installation technician was just as good. Even though it was quite chaotic with other appliances arriving at the same time, they were kind and responsible, explaining everything from how to use the appliances before leaving. I used to think all dishwashers were pretty much the same, but honestly, I would have been flustered if they hadn't shown me how to open the door first. I was surprised by how light the door was, and amazed by the cleaning power. I realized just how much Samsung's appliances have advanced. It made me realize they aren't just a company that makes cell phones. AI is really good. It opens the door by itself and does the cleaning automatically. I am very satisfied because it seems like my electricity consumption has decreased a bit.
Comments (Original): #삼성전자이벤트참여생활가전은 역시 엘지라고 결혼하고 15년을 엘지만 써왔어요. 이번에 인테리어 하면서 고른 마감재에는 삼성이 찰떡이라고들 하길래 처음으로 삼성가전 구매해봤습니다. 가격적으로도 매리트가 상당히 있었고, 디자인도 상당히 미니멀한것이 외관도 맘에 들더라고요. 주변에 다른 가전가구들과 어우러짐도 말할것도 없고요. 약속된 지정일에 담당 기사님 먼저 방문하셔서 설치환경 확인하시고. 미흡한 부분 고쳐주셨고요. 세상 친절하셨고, 걸레받이도 살짝 절단했는데 외부에서 작업하시고 뒷정리도 완벽하게 해주고 가셨습니다. 설치기사님도 마찬가지로........다른 가전들이랑 동시에 들어와서 상당히 정신없던 와중에도 친절하고 책임감 있게 사용방법 등등 설명해주고 가셨어요. 식세기가 다 거기서 거기지..했었는데 솔직히 문 여는 방법부터 안알려주셨으면 당황했겠더라고요 ㅋㅋㅋ;;;  생각보다 도어가 가벼워서 놀라고, 세척력에 놀랐어요.삼성이 가전이 이렇게 발전했구나.........핸드폰만 만드는 회사가 아니었구나..했습니다^^; AI가 좋긴 좋네요. 문도 알아서 열어주고, 세척도 알아서 해주고.. 전기사용량도 좀 줄어든것 같아서 아주 만족하고 있습니다.

Sentence (English): After moving, I started living with my parents.
Comments (English): [ A Coupang-installed dishwasher with no reason not to buy! ] || ---------------- || After moving, I started living with my parents. After each meal, the amount of dishes to wash naturally doubled compared to when it was just my husband and me! Since my parents are elderly, I couldn't just serve them a quick meal; I had to take out each dish one by one to set the table, and it was unavoidable. The family used to take turns doing the dishes, but even that had its limits. Naturally, the topic of a dishwasher came up before long, and since dishwasher prices are quite reasonable these days... The biggest problem was whether our kitchen would be suitable for installation! It wasn't that the kitchen was small, but strangely, even after measuring the dimensions of other cabinets, they didn't meet the minimum centimeter requirement for that product. It was just a tricky 3-5 cm short. Then, I had a change of perspective. There is a smart oven and a cabinet under the gas range, and the width of that area fits perfectly into the dishwasher installation specifications! It seemed like I could install it somehow if I just removed that cabinet and the smart oven. If I had bought it from a different site, I would have hesitated a lot before deciding to purchase, considering the hassle of a refund if installation didn't work. It felt like Coupang had shouldered those customer concerns with Rocket Installation. (Not an advertisement, just a genuine purchase; I simply felt that Rocket Installation was really convenient for customers.) I went ahead and made the purchase, impressed by the generosity of Rocket Installation, which offers free returns and other fees if installation is difficult due to the environment. We scheduled the installation for about two days later, and received a happy call from the technician around noon the day before. They requested detailed photos of the visit time, the exact dimensions of the installation site, and the condition of the base under the kick plate! With the mindset that we would do everything once the installation was complete, we sent them a thorough response. And indeed, they were professionals. They arrived, removed the heavy smart oven and the built-in cabinets (and neatly organized everything before handing it back so we could restore them later). They installed the dishwasher in a flash. Since it was a model I had used before, I knew how to use it well, but the one mistake I had made until now was putting solid detergent in the rinse aid compartment. You need to put the detergent in the spot I pointed to with my finger. The usage is very intuitive. The function I mainly use is... It is set to Automatic / 1 Hour / Top Quick. If you want to finish really quickly, select Top Quick and tap High Temperature Dry to turn it off, and the wash will be completed within 30 minutes. However, since the drying is done naturally, there will be some moisture when you open it the next day. Sentence (English): After each meal, the amount of dishes to wash naturally doubled compared to when it was just my husband and me!
Comments (English): [ A Coupang-installed dishwasher with no reason not to buy! ] || ---------------- || After moving, I started living with my parents. After each meal, the amount of dishes to wash naturally doubled compared to when it was just my husband and me! Since my parents are elderly, I couldn't just serve them a quick meal; I had to take out each dish one by one to set the table, and it was unavoidable. The family used to take turns doing the dishes, but even that had its limits. Naturally, the topic of a dishwasher came up before long, and since dishwasher prices are quite reasonable these days... The biggest problem was whether our kitchen would be suitable for installation! It wasn't that the kitchen was small, but strangely, even after measuring the dimensions of other cabinets, they didn't meet the minimum centimeter requirement for that product. It was just a tricky 3-5 cm short. Then, I had a change of perspective. There is a smart oven and a cabinet under the gas range, and the width of that area fits perfectly into the dishwasher installation specifications! It seemed like I could install it somehow if I just removed that cabinet and the smart oven. If I had bought it from a different site, I would have hesitated a lot before deciding to purchase, considering the hassle of a refund if installation didn't work. It felt like Coupang had shouldered those customer concerns with Rocket Installation. (Not an advertisement, just a genuine purchase; I simply felt that Rocket Installation was really convenient for customers.) I went ahead and made the purchase, impressed by the generosity of Rocket Installation, which offers free returns and other fees if installation is difficult due to the environment. We scheduled the installation for about two days later, and received a happy call from the technician around noon the day before. They requested detailed photos of the visit time, the exact dimensions of the installation site, and the condition of the base under the kick plate! With the mindset that we would do everything once the installation was complete, we sent them a thorough response. And indeed, they were professionals. They arrived, removed the heavy smart oven and the built-in cabinets (and neatly organized everything before handing it back so we could restore them later). They installed the dishwasher in a flash. Since it was a model I had used before, I knew how to use it well, but the one mistake I had made until now was putting solid detergent in the rinse aid compartment. You need to put the detergent in the spot I pointed to with my finger. The usage is very intuitive. The function I mainly use is... It is set to Automatic / 1 Hour / Top Quick. If you want to finish really quickly, select Top Quick and tap High Temperature Dry to turn it off, and the wash will be completed within 30 minutes. However, since the drying is done naturally, there will be some moisture when you open it the next day. People say that those who have used a dishwasher can never go back to how they used to be, and I completely agree! However, considering the customer convenience and reduced burden provided by Rocket Installation, along with the reasonable price, there is no reason not to buy this.

It was just a tricky 3-5 cm short. Then, I had a change of perspective. There is a smart oven and a cabinet under the gas range, and the width of that area fits perfectly into the dishwasher installation specifications! It seemed like I could install it somehow if I just removed that cabinet and the smart oven. If I had bought it from a different site, I would have hesitated a lot before deciding to purchase, considering the hassle of a refund if installation didn't work. It felt like Coupang had shouldered those customer concerns with Rocket Installation. (Not an advertisement, just a genuine purchase; I simply felt that Rocket Installation was really convenient for customers.) I went ahead and made the purchase, impressed by the generosity of Rocket Installation, which offers free returns and other fees if installation is difficult due to the environment. We scheduled the installation for about two days later, and received a happy call from the technician around noon the day before. They requested detailed photos of the visit time, the exact dimensions of the installation site, and the condition of the base under the kick plate! With the mindset that we would do everything once the installation was complete, we sent them a thorough response. And indeed, they were professionals. They arrived, removed the heavy smart oven and the built-in cabinets (and neatly organized everything before handing it back so we could restore them later). They installed the dishwasher in a flash. Since it was a model I had used before, I knew how to use it well, but the one mistake I had made until now was putting solid detergent in the rinse aid compartment. You need to put the detergent in the spot I pointed to with my finger. The usage is very intuitive. The function I mainly use is... It is set to Automatic / 1 Hour / Top Quick. If you want to finish really quickly, select Top Quick and tap High Temperature Dry to turn it off, and the wash will be completed within 30 minutes. However, since the drying is done naturally, there will be some moisture when you open it the next day. People say that those who have used a dishwasher can never go back to how they used to be, and I completely agree! However, considering the customer convenience and reduced burden provided by Rocket Installation, along with the reasonable price, there is no reason not to buy this.

After each meal, the amount of dishes to wash naturally doubled compared to when it was just my husband and me! Since my parents are elderly, I couldn't just serve them a quick meal; I had to take out each dish one by one to set the table, and it was unavoidable. The family used to take turns doing the dishes, but even that had its limits. Naturally, the topic of a dishwasher came up before long, and since dishwasher prices are quite reasonable these days... The biggest problem was whether our kitchen would be suitable for installation! It wasn't that the kitchen was small, but strangely, even after measuring the dimensions of other cabinets, they didn't meet the minimum centimeter requirement for that product. It was just a tricky 3-5 cm short. Then, I had a change of perspective. There is a smart oven and a cabinet under the gas range, and the width of that area fits perfectly into the dishwasher installation specifications! It seemed like I could install it somehow if I just removed that cabinet and the smart oven. If I had bought it from a different site, I would have hesitated a lot before deciding to purchase, considering the hassle of a refund if installation didn't work. It felt like Coupang had shouldered those customer concerns with Rocket Installation. (Not an advertisement, just a genuine purchase; I simply felt that Rocket Installation was really convenient for customers.) I went ahead and made the purchase, impressed by the generosity of Rocket Installation, which offers free returns and other fees if installation is difficult due to the environment. We scheduled the installation for about two days later, and received a happy call from the technician around noon the day before. They requested detailed photos of the visit time, the exact dimensions of the installation site, and the condition of the base under the kick plate! With the mindset that we would do everything once the installation was complete, we sent them a thorough response. And indeed, they were professionals. They arrived, removed the heavy smart oven and the built-in cabinets (and neatly organized everything before handing it back so we could restore them later). They installed the dishwasher in a flash. Since it was a model I had used before, I knew how to use it well, but the one mistake I had made until now was putting solid detergent in the rinse aid compartment. You need to put the detergent in the spot I pointed to with my finger. The usage is very intuitive. The function I mainly use is... It is set to Automatic / 1 Hour / Top Quick. If you want to finish really quickly, select Top Quick and tap High Temperature Dry to turn it off, and the wash will be completed within 30 minutes. However, since the drying is done naturally, there will be some moisture when you open it the next day. People say that those who have used a dishwasher can never go back to how they used to be, and I completely agree! However, considering the customer convenience and reduced burden provided by Rocket Installation, along with the reasonable price, there is no reason not to buy this.

There is a smart oven and a cabinet under the gas range, and the width of that area fits perfectly into the dishwasher installation specifications! It seemed like I could install it somehow if I just removed that cabinet and the smart oven. If I had bought it from a different site, I would have hesitated a lot before deciding to purchase, considering the hassle of a refund if installation didn't work. It felt like Coupang had shouldered those customer concerns with Rocket Installation. (Not an advertisement, just a genuine purchase; I simply felt that Rocket Installation was really convenient for customers.) With the mindset that we would do everything once the installation was complete, we sent them a thorough response. And indeed, they were professionals. They arrived, removed the heavy smart oven and the built-in cabinets (and neatly organized everything before handing it back so we could restore them later). They installed the dishwasher in a flash. Since it was a model I had used before, I knew how to use it well, but the one mistake I had made until now was putting solid detergent in the rinse aid compartment. You need to put the detergent in the spot I pointed to with my finger. The usage is very intuitive. The function I mainly use is... It is set to Automatic / 1 Hour / Top Quick. If you want to finish really quickly, select Top Quick and tap High Temperature Dry to turn it off, and the wash will be completed within 30 minutes. However, since the drying is done naturally, there will be some moisture when you open it the next day. People say that those who have used a dishwasher can never go back to how they used to be, and I completely agree! However, considering the customer convenience and reduced burden provided by Rocket Installation, along with the reasonable price, there is no reason not to buy this.

Sentence (English): This is a fantastic dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Unbelievably quiet, very customizable ] || ---------------- || This is a fantastic dishwasher. There are so many great features, but I will highlight a few that I think set it apart. First, it is incredibly quiet - to the point where I sometimes can't even tell it's running. Fortunately, there is an indicator light that shines onto the floor while it's running - another neat and unexpected feature. This dishwasher has a third rack for utensils, and there is also a traditional utensil holder in the first rack, so it holds a lot. With my old dishwasher, I was always running out of room and filling up the utensil holder long before I could fill the rest of the dishwasher, which meant running pretty inefficient loads. Not an issue anymore! I was initially skeptical about using the app, but I was curious and decided to give it a shot. I'm glad I did; it has become one of my favorite things about the dishwasher! I like that I can customize options based on what I've actually put in the dishwasher. The "zone wash" is a really nice feature when I have a pot or dish that needs some extra attention, but I don't necessarily want to subject the entire load to a more intense washing. Since the app also tells you the estimated run time and at what time the cycle will finish, it's super convenient to plan when to run it. Overall, the wash cycles take much less time than my previous dishwasher, without sacrificing cleanliness. Comments (English): [ Success in reducing dishwashing labor ] || ---------------- || Washing dishes is surprisingly heavy labor. Even if you work hard cooking and want to rest after a meal, someone always has to do the dishes. Wanting to improve my quality of life, I did a lot of research and finally ordered this. They advised using powder or solid detergent. I settled on the Eco version. It is a bit of a hassle to have to cut it into quarters for the 6-person capacity, but performance and harmlessness are more important to me, so I compromised. I had to wash the pot that had curry in it for a long time one more time, but so far, it cleans other greasy dishes—you know, those kinds of dishes you really hate washing—so thoroughly. Here's a tip: since they provide a drain hose, use it to keep the second batch of water in the sink. Sentence (English): This seller is the worst.
Comments (English): This seller is the worst. I purchased a dishwasher and induction cooktop set, and the technicians contacted me separately before installation. They said they would send photos of the installation location. The induction technician confirmed that installation was possible after receiving a text message, but the dishwasher technician said they would not receive text messages. If a refund is impossible if even one item cannot be installed when purchasing the set, the dishwasher, which always has installation location issues, should have come first. They installed the induction cooktop first and then announced later that the dishwasher was impossible to install. After that, they announced that purchasing only the induction cooktop at the non-discounted price was mandatory. This is forced selling. It was an absurd outcome where the buyer was held responsible despite the technicians' mistake in the installation order. For just the induction cooktop alone, Cuckoo and Navien were 300,000 won cheaper, even with similar specifications! The dishwasher technician mentioned that there are many cases where they went to the site and determined installation was impossible. In that case, there were plenty of ways to resolve it, such as the technician receiving photos the day before or visiting first. I hope there will never be another instance where a buyer suffers due to the dishwasher technician's fault. This has even damaged my perception of Samsung.

Sentence (English): Bought with my own money.
Comments (English): [ I'm really going to escape this dishwashing hell! ] || ---------------- || Bought with my own money. There is nothing in the world as annoying as doing the dishes. Lately, I’ve hated it even more, so I just bought a dishwasher :) For a household of three, it is very, very spacious, and I love that soup bowls and rice bowls fit in with plenty of room. Especially if you live in a multi-unit building like me, or if you were hesitating to install a dishwasher because of a small kitchen, I really recommend this product! My kitchen is literally tiny, but it doesn't feel cramped at all! Since a technician comes and installs it directly, you don't need to worry about the installation, and there are no extra costs! All we have to do is answer the technician's call to coordinate the schedule! That's all. The technician installed it quickly and explained everything thoroughly, so I purchased dishwasher detergent and rinse aid. (I really didn't know anything since it was my first time using one.). There was one thing the technician mentioned as a precaution... You told me to be careful when washing chopsticks! You mentioned that they could break if they slide to the bottom. So, for chopsticks, I make sure to put them in the dedicated basket before running the dishwasher, or I wash them separately just for the chopsticks. Oh! Also, since I'm a total anxious and skeptical person, I was worried about what I would do if they didn't get cleaned properly. Comments (English): [ I am really, really satisfied. ] || ---------------- || I was debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher when this popped up for 280,000 won, so I bought it right away and tried it out. There are exactly three reasons why I chose this product. First, it has three washing blades. Since the washing area is on the first and second floors, I looked for a model with blades in the middle because I thought the area between the first and second floors wouldn't be cleaned well if the blades were only at the very bottom and top. Second, I looked for a model with a hot air drying function. Third, I looked for a model with an automatic door opening feature. You might ask if the door opening function is really necessary if there is hot air drying, but it is because moisture needs to be removed for complete drying. Here is my review after actual use. The first three functions work well, but it is not perfect. Some water remains and it doesn't dry completely. Still, for 280,000 won, I am completely satisfied. If you live alone like me and order takeout because cooking and cleaning up at home is a hassle, buying this is a real money-saving purchase. Just put some frozen rice and a couple of side dishes on the grill, eat, run the dishwasher, and you're done!

Sentence (English): What I am most satisfied with about using the Samsung dishwasher is that it even sterilizes baby bottles.
Comments (English): [ A must-have item if you are making baby food. ] || ---------------- || What I am most satisfied with about using the Samsung dishwasher is that it even sterilizes baby bottles. Hygiene is my biggest concern when raising a child, and since the washing cycle runs at high temperatures, it feels like it catches even invisible germs, which really puts my mind at ease. I love that everything is taken care of in one go without the hassle of boiling and sterilizing separately. Also, washing baby food cubes is incredibly convenient! In the past, washing them one by one by hand took a long time and was cumbersome, but now it is so convenient because I just put them in the dishwasher and run it, and every nook and cranny is cleaned thoroughly. It cleans even the smallest crevices well, so I feel more at ease knowing that hygiene is being maintained. The cleaning power is also better than expected! Even greasy dishes or burnt-on food come out clean without needing to be soaked, which has significantly reduced my dishwashing stress. It was also convenient to have a variety of cycles to choose from depending on the situation. I am also satisfied with the drying function. It dries everything fluffy with hot air, and thanks to the automatic door opening feature, it removes internal moisture, allowing me to use the dishes immediately without any water. It was also great that there were hardly any water stains, reducing the need to wipe them down separately. The noise level is quieter than expected, so it’s not a concern to run it at night. The interior is well-divided, making it convenient to put in baby bottles, baby food containers, and regular tableware all at once. Overall, it feels like it saves time, is hygienic, and convenient all at once, so I am really satisfied with it as a parenting item. However, if you don't control the amount of detergent properly, some residue may remain on the dishes.

Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. I have been using a 6-place setting dishwasher ever since getting married in 2003. I used to constantly swap between Dongyang Me* and SK Me* products, but this year I switched to a Samsung Bespoke dishwasher. There wasn't anything particularly special or new about it, except that the door opens automatically. That said, there weren't any specific downsides either, but after using it for a few months, something that really stressed me out occurred. Chopsticks kept sticking out of the cutlery holder and obstructing the rotating blades in the bottom compartment, causing it to stop. Even when that didn't happen, chopsticks would get stuck when organizing after drying, and pulling them out was a frustrating experience every time. This was something I never had to pay attention to or worry about even once while using my previous dishwasher for over 20 years. It was quite a hassle to have to be careful every time I put the chopsticks back into the holder. I thought that if the grooves had been as dense as the bottom of the cutlery holder—even just 2-3cm high—this wouldn't have been the case. After much deliberation, I replaced it with a 5,000-won stainless steel cutlery holder from Daiso, and my quality of life has changed dramatically, freeing me from stress. The installer guy said for this dishwasher, I should be sure to rinse the dishes before putting them, making sure there isn't any food on them so we are basically washing them before the dishwasher washes and sanitizes them. They do come out nice and clean after that. It's only been a couple of weeks and we are still learning and experimenting with it but so far so good. By the way, the extended warranty is not through Lowe's, it is an independent company sold through Lowe's.

Comments (English): [ With top and bottom nozzles for reliable cleaning power, and even interior lighting and a window. ] || ---------------- || With four nozzles on the top and bottom, it offers excellent cleaning power, and it is a very convenient and pretty dishwasher featuring interior lighting and even a window. The SK 6-place setting dishwasher we used very well at our shop happened to break down, so instead of repairing it, I decided to take this opportunity to replace it with a new one and purchased the My Dear Automatic Door Opening UV Lamp Dishwasher. To be honest, this was the first time I had heard of the My Dear brand, so I was a bit skeptical at first. However, once I received it and installed it in the kitchen, I was very pleased with it because the design is clean, sophisticated, and free of clutter, matching the kitchen interior perfectly. In particular, the most satisfying aspect compared to the SK product I used previously is the water nozzle. After doing some research, I found that the MyDear product features a multi-directional spray design that includes upper and lower rotating blades. My old model only had two nozzles at the bottom, so sometimes the top sections wouldn't get cleaned properly when dishes were stacked. However, this model is equipped with four nozzles that spray thoroughly both upwards and downwards. Perhaps because of this, it cleans every nook and cranny of the dishes powerfully and thoroughly without any blind spots, making it far superior and more satisfying in terms of cleaning performance. Also, a feature that I never expected to find so convenient is the interior lighting. My workplace is a bit dark, so I usually have to load or unload dishes in a dim environment; however, since the interior of the dishwasher is brightly lit, my visibility is wide open, making the work much more comfortable. Furthermore, the large window at the front allows me to intuitively monitor the entire washing process, which is also quite appealing. However, if there is one slight drawback, it is the lack of the short 20-minute quick wash cycle that was on the previous model. That short cycle was really useful when I occasionally wanted to quickly wash just a few cups or light, non-greasy dishes, so the only flaw is that it takes a little longer because that feature is missing. Nevertheless, since it reliably supports automatic door opening and UV lamp sterilization, and offers perfect cleaning power with four nozzles (top and bottom), I am overall very satisfied with it. If you are looking for a 6-place setting dishwasher with good value, a clean design, and excellent cleaning power, you definitely won't regret considering the MyDear product.

Sentence (English): Purchased to replace a 12 year old GE dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good basic dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Purchased to replace a 12 year old GE dishwasher. I like the stainless steel inside. This dishwasher sits much lower than my old one, I suppose to accommodate taller items. I do not like the lower rack as it doesn't have tines all the way across. Where I used to run a load 3-4 times per week, I find I'm running loads daily because I can't fit everything I could with my old one. Even though it is quieter than my old one, it makes a lot of clicking sounds while running too. Oh well. It's just a dishwasher and the price was good and the service provided through Costco (Allegro) was great.

Comments (English): [ It cleans even the grease thoroughly. ] || ---------------- || I installed one at my mom's house. I wanted her, who recently moved to a country house, to be freed from the chore of washing dishes, even if just a little. I considered installing a different brand, but my mom thinks only LG Electronics is good, so we ended up getting all LG appliances when she moved. I was worried that installation might not be possible since we live in a rural area, but I was relieved that it was installed. The natural beige color matches anywhere, and the design is clean. My interior is all white, so I was worried the natural beige dishwasher might look a bit out of place, but it blends in naturally, as if it belongs right there. The cleaning power is excellent. The shelves are divided into sections, making it easy to place cutlery, cups, and dishes in their designated spots. It has a Grade 1 energy efficiency rating. Since power consumption is so efficient, I feel less pressure regarding electricity bills. It also features an automatic door opening function. It is a useful feature for drying dishes once the washing is complete. Even if you don't use the drying function, the dishwasher automatically opens the door after the wash is finished and the dishes air dry after a while. It is convenient. It is quiet. I use a dishwasher from another brand, and this one operates with less noise than that. It is quiet enough that it is not particularly bothersome. Washing and drying work well even without using the hot air or drying functions. My mom tried it a few times and liked it, saying that even greasy dishes are cleaned well. Although they say pre-washing isn't necessary, my mom always makes sure to pre-wash them. Anyway, I feel proud that my mom is satisfied with it.

Comments (English): [ It's so good. I feel more at ease. ] || ---------------- || I purchased the Samsung Bespoke Countertop Dishwasher after struggling with the stress of dishwashing, and I am using it with such satisfaction that I wonder why I didn't buy it sooner. I was worried that the 6-place setting might be too big, but after actually installing it, it fits well in my kitchen space, and the clean design doesn't detract from the interior. In particular, the Bespoke White color looks really luxurious and seems to fit well in any kitchen. The part I am most satisfied with is, of course, the cleaning power. I was surprised that greasy dishes, pots, and even dishes with burnt-on rice were cleaned much more thoroughly than I expected. There are fewer water stains than when washing by hand, and the glass cups look even shinier. Since it uses high-temperature washing, I feel like I am keeping things hygienic, so I feel at ease when washing my children's dishes. Dishwashing used to take a long time, but now that I just have to press a button, my quality of life has truly improved. The noise is also quieter than I expected, so it wasn't bothersome even when running it in the evening or at night. I thought installation would be complicated since it is a countertop model, but the visiting technician explained everything kindly and the installation was done neatly. The interior space is wider than I expected, so it fits plates, soup bowls, and cups neatly, making it easy to organize. I also liked the water usage and time savings. It feels like less water is wasted compared to washing by hand, and I am truly satisfied that I can use the time I used to spend on dishwashing for other household chores or relaxation. It seems like a well-balanced product overall, considering design, performance, and convenience. I highly recommend this product, especially to newlyweds, families with children, or anyone looking to reduce dishwashing stress. Since it is an appliance I use every day, satisfaction was important to me, and I believe this purchase was a really good choice.

Sentence (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation.
Comments (English): #SamsungElectronicsEventParticipation. I spent about half a year agonizing over buying a dishwasher for my parents, searching high and low, and I think I made the right decision. First off, I didn't consider a 12-place setting model from the start because you have to bend over, and even without that, storage space was already lacking. Among the 6-place setting models, I wanted one that was a bit larger, and it also needed to dry thoroughly. I went through the process of selecting one, carefully comparing the options, choosing another, and comparing them again, until I finally chose the Samsung dishwasher. I received it yesterday and deliberately packed it full to the brim. After eating soft tofu stew, I crammed the pot and dishes covered in red oil sauce, along with all sorts of miscellaneous items, into the machine so tightly that I couldn't even play Tetris properly—pile just enough space for the water jets to rotate. Then, I anxiously waited for it to finish, and when I took everything out, it was squeaky clean. Even the plastic cups, which had become sticky from being left out for so long, were completely smooth and spotless. I was truly satisfied. I took this photo because it suddenly occurred to me while I was taking out dishes from the front. You can really tell from the picture just how haphazardly I packed them in. Sentence (English): Extremely disappointed – dishwasher racks rusting after just a few months.
Comments (English): Extremely disappointed – dishwasher racks rusting after just a few months. We moved into this home in November 2024 and purchased a GE Energy Star dishwasher (front controls, model GDF510PSRSS). Within a short time, the racks started rusting severely. Photos show obvious rust on multiple tines and bars, and the racks already feel fragile and prone to breaking. This is unacceptable for a new appliance and has already caused me to question the overall quality and durability. I expected better corrosion resistance from GE, especially for a new unit. Highly dissatisfied with performance and longevity.Would strongly discourage others from expecting long-term rack durability from this model. If you own one, inspect the racks early and reach out to support if you notice corrosion—your experience may vary, but mine has been disappointing from the start.

Sentence (English): Three-line summary.
Comments (English): [ 2026 Best-Buying Home Appliances: Overwhelming No. 1 ] || ---------------- || Three-line summary. A cost-effective dishwasher that gives back 40 minutes of daily dishwashing time. I was worried about the cleaning power, but dishes come out spotlessly clean, without a single trace of grease. It is a shame that it lacks an automatic door opening, but other than that, there is nothing to criticize. *Important*. Some people mention cleaning power issues; since the washing blades are located only at the bottom, dishes may not be cleaned properly if you do not clean the nozzles periodically. Please keep this in mind when maintaining the product! 1. Motivation for Purchase. Doing the dishes twice a day, taking over 20 minutes each time, made me feel like I was wasting too much time. After considering dishwashers, which are considered one of the "three essential appliances" for newlyweds, I chose the Midea dishwasher. I hesitated because of reviews mentioning disappointing cleaning power, but the specs seemed decent for the price, so I eventually decided to give it a try. I considered products from major corporations, but after confirming that many are OEM products—meaning the same item is sold under different brands—I decided to buy the cheapest one with the same specs. 2. Satisfaction After Use. To start with the conclusion, I am extremely satisfied. My concerns about cleaning power were unfounded, and since there is almost no noise, I experienced no inconvenience while using it. The technician handled the installation neatly, and the structure is so simple that it seems perfectly feasible to install it yourself when moving in the future. 3. Product Impressions. Cleaning Power: Contrary to my concerns, it was excellent. Since it washes with hot water, absolutely no grease remained on the dishes. Capacity: Although it is rated for 6 people, it feels most suitable for a household of 3 to 4. As shown in the photo, it can comfortably store rice bowls, soup bowls, and plates. Noise: It is quiet even while operating, so it is not bothersome even when standing right next to it. Maintenance Costs: Some people say that dishwasher detergent is expensive, but for the 6-person capacity, using just half the amount of standard detergent is sufficient for thorough cleaning, so the maintenance cost burden is not significant. Installation: The technician came and took care of everything from connecting the water supply to draining, and because the structure is simple, it didn't seem difficult to install it yourself after moving. 4. Usage Tips. Since there is no automatic door opening function, it is recommended to manually open the door to ventilate after the wash is complete. It is more convenient to run it at a set time rather than right before bed. There was no significant difference in cleaning performance even when using only about half the recommended amount of detergent. 5. Pros & Cons. Pros: Unrivaled value for money; the cleaning power at this price is fully justifiable. Almost no operating noise, so there is no inconvenience during use. Time-saving effect, fully reclaiming over 40 minutes of daily dishwashing time. Cons: Lack of an automatic door opening function (requires opening manually after washing to ventilate). Although labeled as a 6-place setting, the capacity is more suitable for 3-4 people in actual use. Unsuitable for washing large loads due to the absence of a top fin. 6. Personal Review & Repurchase Intention & Recommended for: If you cook at home, I believe a dishwasher is the very first item you should purchase among the "three essential appliances" for newlyweds. Being able to use the time previously spent twice a day on dishwashing for other tasks is a significant improvement in quality of life. If you are considering getting a dishwasher or are still unsure about its necessity, I recommend starting with the Midea dishwasher. Pros and Cons: Pros: Aesthetic Perfection: The Nature Beige color harmonizes perfectly with the kitchen base cabinets, making the kitchen look much more luxurious after installation. Cleaning Power: High-temperature sterilization removes grime from crevices and stubborn grease stains that are difficult to clean by hand, leaving everything squeaky clean. Cons: Installation Restrictions: Since it is a built-in model, modifications to the sink base cabinets are essential, so there is a slight inconvenience in having to carefully check the dimensions beforehand. Maintenance: Because of the white/beige tones, fingerprints or stains on the door surface can be noticeable, so it needs to be wiped occasionally. User Review: After actually using it, I can immediately feel why it is called a "quality-enhancing appliance." The greatest happiness is being able to use the spare time entirely for myself simply by stacking the dishes neatly after a meal and starting the machine. In particular, there are various washing modes in addition to the standard course that allow me to adjust according to the situation, and the feature where the door automatically opens after washing to release internal moisture and odors is truly smart. The drying performance is also excellent, leaving the dishes neat enough to be put away in the cabinet immediately. I will definitely repurchase this! It is a grateful item that not only offers the neatness of a built-in unit that fits perfectly into the base cabinet, but also completely frees me from dishwashing stress. I am so satisfied with both the design and functionality that I would unconditionally recommend this Objet line to any friend or acquaintance considering a dishwasher. If my review was helpful, please give it a thumbs up. Thank you!

Comments (English): Motivation for Purchase: I often felt that washing dishes took longer than cooking. Especially on days when I ate greasy food or when guests came over, seeing the pile of dishes would make me sigh. I was looking for a product with powerful cleaning capabilities that wouldn't detract from my kitchen decor, and I ultimately decided on a reliable LG product due to its sleek, objet-like design. Pros and Cons: Pros: Aesthetic Perfection: The Nature Beige color harmonizes perfectly with the kitchen base cabinets, making the kitchen look much more luxurious after installation. Ample Capacity: Being a 12-place setting model, it is incredibly convenient that large cooking utensils like pots and pans fit comfortably inside at once. Cleaning Power: High-temperature sterilization removes grime from crevices and stubborn grease stains that are difficult to clean by hand, leaving everything squeaky clean. Cons: Installation Restrictions: Since it is a built-in model, modifications to the sink base cabinets are essential, so there is a slight inconvenience in having to carefully check the dimensions beforehand. Maintenance: Because of the white/beige tones, fingerprints or stains on the door surface can be noticeable, so it needs to be wiped occasionally. User Review: After actually using it, I can immediately feel why it is called a "quality-enhancing appliance." The greatest happiness is being able to use the spare time entirely for myself simply by stacking the dishes neatly after a meal and starting the machine. In particular, there are various washing modes in addition to the standard course that allow me to adjust according to the situation, and the feature where the door automatically opens after washing to release internal moisture and odors is truly smart. The drying performance is also excellent, leaving the dishes neat enough to be put away in the cabinet immediately. I will definitely repurchase this! It is a grateful item that not only offers the neatness of a built-in unit that fits perfectly into the base cabinet, but also completely frees me from dishwashing stress. I am so satisfied with both the design and functionality that I would unconditionally recommend this Objet line to any friend or acquaintance considering a dishwasher. If my review was helpful, please give it a thumbs up. Thank you!

The lower silverware rack is strange with the narrow holders, which only allow certain types of narrow handles for silverware. So far about 1 in 10 pieces of silverware does not get cleaned properly in that rack. I prefer my old top rack for silverware, it worked a lot better and was less work. I actually have to spin the arms to make sure they don't hit anything before every wash, which seems unreasonable to me and is a pain. We will give it another week or so and call the manufacturer to get ideas, but this dishwasher is definitely not working well for us at this point. I am disappointed to say the least.

Comments (English): [ Poor experience with Home Depot and Allstate Protection ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher from along with a 5-year protection plan through Allstate Protection Plans, and unfortunately, the experience has been extremely disappointing.Not long after installation, the dishwasher stopped cleaning properly, dishes were consistently coming out dirty. Around the same time, a small plastic strip on the control panel began to peel off, but that was a minor cosmetic issue and not our primary concern.It took multiple frustrating attempts just to get service scheduled through Allstate. When a technician finally came, he arrived outside the agreed service window, and only my young daughter was home at the time. Instead of addressing the actual problem with the dishwasher's performance, he focused solely on the cosmetic issue with the plastic strip and concluded that the issue was “external.” He left without repairing the appliance—even though replacement parts had already been sent by Home Depot.I followed up several times to clarify that the real issue was internal and that the dishwasher was not functioning properly. Despite this, I repeatedly received the same generic response stating that the issue was external and not covered. When I asked to speak with a supervisor, I was told that these decisions are handled “on the backend” and that speaking to someone directly was not an option.To make matters worse, our warranty expired in April, leaving us with a non-functioning dishwasher and no resolution—despite having paid several hundred dollars for coverage.Based on this experience, I would strongly caution others against purchasing appliances from Home Depot if you're relying on their protection plans. The Allstate warranty, in our case, provided little to no value and made an already frustrating situation even worse.I hope this helps others make a more informed decision.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher to escape the hell of dishwashing, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?"
Comments (English): I bought this dishwasher to escape the hell of dishwashing, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?" 1. The majesty of a spacious 14-place setting (storage capacity). The exterior dimensions are almost the same as the previous 12-place model, but the interior storage space is designed to be incredibly efficient. Large-capacity storage: It is wide enough to handle not only pots and pans but also dishes for a family of six at once. Smart shelves: You can adjust the height or fold the shelves according to the shape of the dishes, making it much easier to "Tetris" with them. 2. Reliable cleaning power and steam function. 100% TrueSteam: Thanks to high-temperature steam, even greasy pork belly pans or burnt-on rice are cleaned very cleanly. Above all, I use it with peace of mind because it feels like it is sterilizing and disinfecting. QuadWash: The nozzles at the bottom rotate to spray a powerful stream of water, ensuring that every nook and cranny is cleaned thoroughly without any blind spots. 3. The harmony of 'Hot Air Drying' and 'Automatic Door Opening'. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release internal moisture. With the added hot air drying function, even the water remaining in plastic containers dries up completely. They are so dry that you can put them in the cupboard right away. 4. Quiet operation and sleek design. It is so quiet that you can barely hear it in the living room, even if you run it late at night. You can start it after dinner, relax in the living room, and it will be finished before you know it. Furthermore, the matte and sophisticated colors signature of the Objet Collection match the kitchen base cabinets perfectly, making it an excellent addition to your interior decor. Overall Review: My quality of life has skyrocketed! The biggest advantage is that I now have the time to play with my child or enjoy a cup of tea instead of doing the dishes. If you are considering the 12-place setting, I recommend going for the slightly more spacious 14-place setting without hesitation!
Comments (Original): 설거지 지옥에서 벗어나고 싶어 들인 식기세척기, 결론부터 말씀드리면 '왜 이제 샀나' 싶을 정도로 만족스럽습니다.​1. 넉넉한 14인용의 위엄 (수납력)​기존 12인용과 외관 사이즈는 거의 같은데, 내부 수납 공간이 정말 알차게 설계됐어요.​대용량 수납: 냄비나 프라이팬은 기본이고, 6인 가족 식기도 한 번에 해결 가능할 만큼 넓습니다.​스마트 선반: 식기 모양에 따라 높낮이를 조절하거나 선반을 접을 수 있어 테트리스 하기가 훨씬 수월해졌어요.​2. 믿고 쓰는 세척력과 스팀 기능​100℃ 트루스팀: 고온 스팀 덕분에 기름기가 많은 삼겹살 팬이나 눌어붙은 밥풀도 아주 깔끔하게 닦입니다. 무엇보다 살균 소독이 되는 느낌이라 안심하고 사용해요.​쿼드워시: 바닥의 노즐이 돌아가며 강력한 물살을 쏴주니까 사각지대 없이 구석구석 깨끗해집니다.​3. '열풍 건조'와 '자동 문 열림'의 조화​세척이 끝나면 자동으로 문이 살짝 열리면서 내부 습기를 내보내 주는데, 여기에 열풍 건조 기능까지 더해지니 플라스틱 용기에 남는 물기까지 싹 말라있더라고요. 바로 찬장에 넣어도 될 정도로 뽀송합니다.​4. 조용한 구동음과 깔끔한 디자인​밤늦게 돌려도 거실에서 소리가 거의 들리지 않을 정도로 정숙합니다. 저녁 먹고 돌려놓은 뒤 거실에서 쉬다 보면 어느새 끝날 정도예요. 게다가 오브제컬렉션 특유의 매트하고 세련된 컬러가 주방 하부장이랑 찰떡이라 인테리어 효과도 만점입니다.​총평: 삶의 질이 수직 상승합니다!​설거지할 시간에 아이랑 더 놀아주거나 차 한 잔 마실 여유가 생겼다는 게 가장 큰 장점이에요. 12인용 고민하시는 분들이라면 고민 말고 조금 더 여유로운 14인용으로 가시길 추천드립니다!

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher to escape the hell of dishwashing, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?"
Comments (English): I bought this dishwasher to escape the hell of dishwashing, and to start with the conclusion, I am so satisfied that I wonder, "Why did I wait so long to buy this?" 1. The majesty of a spacious 14-place setting (storage capacity). The exterior dimensions are almost the same as the previous 12-place model, but the interior storage space is designed to be incredibly efficient. Large-capacity storage: It is wide enough to handle not only pots and pans but also dishes for a family of six all at once. Smart shelves: You can adjust the height or fold the shelves according to the shape of the dishes, making it much easier to "Tetris" (arrange dishes). 2. Reliable cleaning power and steam function. 100% TrueSteam: Thanks to high-temperature steam, even greasy pork belly pans or burnt-on rice are cleaned very cleanly. Above all, I use it with peace of mind because it feels like it is sterilizing and disinfecting. QuadWash: The nozzles at the bottom rotate to spray a powerful stream of water, ensuring that every nook and cranny is cleaned thoroughly without any blind spots. 3. The harmony of 'Hot Air Drying' and 'Automatic Door Opening'. Once the wash is finished, the door automatically opens slightly to release internal moisture. With the added hot air drying function, even the water remaining in plastic containers dries up completely. They are so dry that you can put them in the cupboard right away. 4. Quiet operation and sleek design. It is so quiet that you can barely hear it in the living room, even if you run it late at night. You can start it after dinner, relax in the living room, and it will be finished before you know it. Furthermore, the matte and sophisticated colors signature of the Objet Collection match the kitchen base cabinets perfectly, making it an excellent addition to your interior decor. Overall Review: My quality of life has skyrocketed! The biggest advantage is that I now have the time to play with my child or enjoy a cup of tea instead of doing the dishes. If you are considering the 12-place setting, I recommend going for the slightly more spacious 14-place setting without hesitation!

Comments (English): I was satisfied that the product was delivered on the date I requested. The display and button controls were intuitive, making it convenient to use, and the installation technician was kind, so the overall installation process was excellent. Sentence (English): I replaced a 19-year old dishwasher with the Bosch 800.
Comments (English): [ Took some getting used to; truly satisfied ] || ---------------- || I replaced a 19-year old dishwasher with the Bosch 800. With my old unit we used 30-minute (or less) quick cycles regularly. You can't really do that with the Bosch. Due to the lower water usage and lack of a dedicated heated drying element, the Bosch quick cycles leave the interior of the washer very wet (so much so that everything required hand-towel drying.) So, we changed to the recommended "automatic" mode with the "sanitize" setting (uses hotter water). While the cycles now take considerably longer, the result is very good - we are now more organized to wash overnight versus quick daytime washes. The Bosch is exceedingly quiet (so much so that you can't be sure that it is on without checking the operating light). I am giving the product a "4" rating because the loading racks could be structured to better accommodate wider/longer products (such as Pyrex casserole dishes or cutting boards). Overall, I would purchase this unit again.

So, we changed to the recommended "automatic" mode with the "sanitize" setting (uses hotter water). While the cycles now take considerably longer, the result is very good - we are now more organized to wash overnight versus quick daytime washes. The Bosch is exceedingly quiet (so much so that you can't be sure that it is on without checking the operating light). I am giving the product a "4" rating because the loading racks could be structured to better accommodate wider/longer products (such as Pyrex casserole dishes or cutting boards). Overall, I would purchase this unit again.

Sentence (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place capacity (Essential White).
Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.
