Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Comments (English): An honest review of the Samsung BESPOKE AI Built-in Dishwasher 14-Place Capacity (Essential White). They say dishwashers are one of the "three essential home appliances," and now that I've had the BESPOKE AI 14-place capacity installed, I regret not buying it sooner. I debated between the 12-place and 14-place models, but trusting the saying "bigger is better," I went with the 14-place one. I will summarize the realistic pros and cons I've experienced, starting from the actual installation process and using it for a month. Installation and Design (The finishing touch to your kitchen interior). On-site Installation: The technician visited beforehand to meticulously check the dimensions of the base cabinets. Since it is a built-in model, the satisfaction of seeing it fit perfectly under the sink is incredible. The Essential White color makes the kitchen look much brighter and cleaner. It is a clean, matte white that doesn't show fingerprints easily, making it easy to maintain. The Majesty of the 14-Place Capacity: The interior space is truly vast. With a three-tier storage structure, cutlery fits on top, rice bowls in the middle, and even large pots or frying pans at the bottom—all in one go. For a family of four, there is plenty of room even if you do a day's worth of dishwashing all at once. Washing Power and Drying Performance (Hot Air Drying is the Key!) • AI Customized Wash: It automatically detects the level of dirt on the dishes and adjusts the wash time and temperature, so I don't have to worry about anything. Even burnt-on rice and greasy grill pans come out squeaky clean. • Hot Air Drying: This is the biggest reason I chose this model! With standard automatic door-opening drying, moisture is bound to remain in plastic containers, but thanks to the hot air drying function, even the water droplets on the bottom of cups or plastic containers dry completely. You can stylishly take them out and put them in the cabinet right away. • Convenience Features and Noise (A Helper for Quiet Nights) • Low Noise Design: It is quiet enough that I can run it late at night and watch TV in the living room without being bothered. I love being able to run it comfortably after work without worrying about noise disturbing the neighbors. • SmartThings: It is efficient to check the remaining time and receive notifications when the wash is complete on my phone. The notification that comes when the detergent is running low is also a surprisingly handy feature. • Areas for Improvement (Realistic Aspects). Utensil Storage: Although it is large since it is a 14-place setting, long utensils like ladles or whisks sometimes get caught on the rotating blades in the bottom compartment if the angles aren't right when arranging them in the upper cabinets. You need some know-how to stack them skillfully. Washing Time: It takes quite a while if you add the hot air drying function to the powerful cycle. I end up using the standard cycle when I'm in a hurry, but it is best to run it with plenty of time to spare. Overall Review: This is the best gift for anyone who wants to escape the hell of dishwashing. In particular, if you hate water residue on plastic, I highly recommend going for the hot air drying model. My quality of life has skyrocketed because the kitchen chores have been reduced, giving me more free time in the evenings! If you are planning a remodel or appliance replacement, the Bespoke 14-place setting will be a choice you won't regret.

Sentence (English): For Parents' Day on May 8th!
Comments (English): [ A mistake from the mainland? A mistake by Coupang! A dishwasher with insane value for money ] || ---------------- || For Parents' Day on May 8th! A review of a gift I bought with my own money by K-eldest daughter Ddalrangbanggu—someone who hates doing the dishes but wants to be a dutiful daughter! (A genuine review, not using AI). Since it was the Coupang appliance sale period and in celebration of Parents' Day, I gave this as a gift to my mother. As my mother gets older, she finds washing dishes a bit difficult because she has to bend over every time. So, I planned to buy an organic dishwasher, but the ones from Samsung and Cuckoo were more expensive than I expected, and I heard that even major brands have frequent breakdowns. While looking for a cost-effective option, I discovered the My Dear product! My Dear, also known as Midea, is a Chinese brand that manufactures small appliances for companies like Samsung Electronics and Cuckoo on a contract basis! The installation technician also told me that it is not lacking in performance at all. I received the installation the very next day after purchasing, on May 5th! I thought installation wouldn't be possible because it was Children's Day, but the technician visited and installed it kindly. We thought it was artificial marble, but it turned out to be natural marble, so installation almost became impossible. However, the technician cleverly drilled a hole in the sink to install it perfectly. The cost was 30,000 won! This is our first time using a dishwasher; if you use the soaking or high-temperature functions, it runs for about two hours. To be honest, it is quite noisy. It feels a bit like a top-loading washing machine. And here's a huge advantage! Sentence (English): I was debating between a 12-place setting and a 6-place setting because I heard that bigger is better, but for a two-person household, the Samsung 6-place setting seems to be the perfect fit!
Comments (English): [ Perfect for a two-person household! ] || ---------------- || I was debating between a 12-place setting and a 6-place setting because I heard that bigger is better, but for a two-person household, the Samsung 6-place setting seems to be the perfect fit! It is so convenient to wash dishes as they are, so they don't pile up! It is larger than other 6-place setting dishwashers from other companies, so I initially failed to install it due to lack of space, but after making space again for installation, I feel I made the right choice with no regrets. Honestly, cleaning power seems to vary depending on the detergent. Also, three saucepans fit easily. However, a large 28cm wok fills up completely when placed with dishes for a two-person meal, and water streaks appear, so I feel more at ease hand-washing non-stick frying pans and pressure cookers. Still, I am satisfied because dishwashing time has been reduced to one-tenth. The amount of dishes in the photo is not very much, so I didn't put in a lot; even when I piled them up high, they cleaned well. Only the bottom part is plastic; everything from the lid onwards is stainless steel. Also, if you detach the strainer and scrub it with a brush whenever you remember, it cleans up nicely. I didn't find it particularly inconvenient.
Comments (Original): [ 2인가구에 딱좋다! ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기 클수록 좋다해서 12인용이랑 6인용이랑 고민하고있었는데, 2인가구 기준 삼성 6인용은 딱 맞는것 같습니다!! 설거지 거리 그때그때 식세기에 처리하면 쌓이지도않고 너무 편합니다!! 다른 6인용 식세기 회사꺼보다 큰편이라 공간이 부족해 실패하고 다시 공간만들어서 설치했더니 후회없이 잘선택한것같습니다~~세정력은 솔직히 세제에 따른 차이인거같습니다.또 편수냄비 3개는 거뜬히 들어갑니다. 다만 28cm 큰 웍은 2인 한끼분량 그릇과 넣으면 가득차고 식세기 물줄기 자국이생겨서 코팅후라이팬, 압력밥솥은 손설거지가 마음편합니다. 그래도 설거지시간이 10분의 1로 줄어서 만족합니다.사진에 설거지양은 많이 없어서 많이 안넣은편이고 많을때는 가득쌓아도 잘씻기는 편이었습니다.바닥쪽만 플라스틱부분있고 뚜껑부터 다 스텐입니다.또 거름망쪽 분리해서 생각날때마다 솔로 닦아내면 깨끗하게 잘 닦입니다~~ 별로 불편한부분은 없었습니다~

Sentence (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing.
Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

(구독 시 포함된 세제를 쓰는 게 가장 속 편합니다.)​테트리스가 핵심: 그릇 겹침 없이 물살이 잘 닿도록 배치하는 #39;테트리스#39; 능력만 키우면 세척 효율이 200% 올라갑니다.​6. 최종 총평: quot;망설임은 설치만 늦출 뿐quot;​처음에는 매달 나가는 구독료가 아깝지 않을까 걱정했지만, 지난 1년을 돌아보니 #39;시간#39;과 #39;건강#39;을 샀다는 결론에 도달했습니다. 특히 전문가가 정기적으로 방문해 기기 상태를 최상으로 유지해주니, 기계 고장 걱정 없이 마음 편히 사용할 수 있었습니다.​식기세척기 구매를 고민 중이시라면, 그리고 관리에 자신이 없다면 구독 서비스를 강력 추천합니다. 설거지 지옥에서 벗어나는 순간, 당신의 저녁 풍경이 바뀔 것입니다.​한 줄 요약: quot;구독료는 내 손목 치료비와 스트레스 해소비로 충분히 가치가 있다!quot;

Sentence (English): When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius.
Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

Comments (English): [Review] Dishwasher Subscription Management: A Record of a Year Escaping the Hell of Dishwashing. In our household, where we are a dual-income couple raising a young child, "dishwashing" was always a source of conflict. When we finally decided to bite the bullet and get a dishwasher, choosing a **"subscription management service"** instead of a one-time purchase turned out to be a stroke of genius. Based on my experience over the past year, I will share the pros and cons of the subscription service and the details of the management service. 1. Why "Subscription" Instead of "Purchase"? At first, buying it outright at an appliance store seemed cheaper. However, I was concerned that dishwashers are tricky to maintain because they are constantly exposed to water and detergent, leading to issues like limescale, mold, and drain odors. Zero Initial Cost: I was able to use the latest model for around 20,000 to 30,000 won per month without any lump-sum expenditure. Professional Care: The ability to regularly receive internal disassembly cleaning and sterilization services, which are difficult for the average person to perform, was very appealing. No More Worries About Consumables: There was an option to have consumables, such as detergent, rinse aid, and filters, delivered or refilled according to their replacement cycles, so I didn't have to worry about anything. 2. The Reality of the Regular Maintenance Service (Visit Care). The core of the subscription is **#39% Manager Visit Care#39%**. A professional usually visits every 4 to 6 months, but when I tried it myself, it was on a completely different level. Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Nozzle Hole Inspection: Cleaning power decreases if limescale or foreign matter accumulates in the water outlet nozzle holes, so these are checked one by one. Door Gasket Cleaning: Water stains and mold trapped between the rubber gaskets are wiped away with a specialized cleaner to prevent leaks and odors. My Impression: It was so thorough that I naturally thought, "If I had managed this on my own, I would have just wiped the exterior haphazardly." In particular, the refreshing scent emanating from inside the machine after steam sterilization provides a great sense of psychological satisfaction. 3. Changes in quality of life experienced through actual use. More free time (securing an average of 40 minutes per day). The time I used to stand in front of the sink after dinner has disappeared. I now have the leisure to read an extra book with my child or enjoy a cup of coffee with my husband. Over a year, this amounts to getting back about 240 hours. Powerful cleaning power and hygiene. The doubt that "washing by hand might be cleaner" vanished after the first run. Thanks to high-temperature washing, grease is completely removed, and the dishes make a "squeaky clean" sound. The sense of reassurance I feel when running baby bottles or children's tableware in sterilization mode is irreplaceable. Skin protection. I am completely free from the housewife's eczema I used to suffer from every winter. The skin troubles caused by my hands swelling from hot water, even when wearing rubber gloves, have disappeared. 5. Pro tips after one year of use. Pre-wash lightly: For items heavily stained with seasoning, simply rinse them quickly with water. Modern dishwashers are high-performance and can clean almost anything. However, if you wash items too thoroughly before putting them in, there may be no room for the detergent to work, which can actually degrade performance. Use dedicated detergent: Be sure to use dishwasher-specific detergent and rinse aid. Using rinse aid dramatically improves drying performance. (It is most convenient to use the detergent included with your subscription.) Tetris is key: If you master the 'Tetris' skill of arranging dishes without overlapping so that the water streams reach them well, your cleaning efficiency will increase by 200%. 6. Final Review: "Hesitation only delays installation." At first, I worried that the monthly subscription fee might be a waste, but looking back on the past year, I have come to the conclusion that I bought 'time' and 'health.' In particular, since experts visit regularly to keep the machine in top condition, I was able to use it with peace of mind without worrying about breakdowns. If you are considering purchasing a dishwasher and lack confidence in maintenance, I highly recommend a subscription service. The moment you escape the hell of dishwashing, your evening landscape will change. One-line summary: "The subscription fee is well worth it for my wrist treatment and stress relief!"

Key Maintenance Process: Filter and Strainer Cleaning: The drain filter, prone to food residue buildup, is disassembled and cleaned using high pressure. Internal Steam Sterilization: Invisible bacteria on the interior walls and basket are eradicated using high-temperature steam exceeding 100°C. Sentence (English): So far we are happy with the dishwasher itself.
Comments (English): [ Good dishwasher, lousy instructions ] || ---------------- || So far we are happy with the dishwasher itself. It's a nice, mid-range model. The trend of having the control button along the top edge of the door still confuses me. It's easy to tap a button just opening or closing the door. The extremely bright light on the door that indicates that they washer is running serves as an interesting night light in the kitchen. The appliance itself is just fine, as far as I can tell.The installation (DIY) is another matter. First, the instructions are awful. GE has one installation manual for three different models which just confuses things. They are also vague, often telling you to do something without telling you how to do it. Second, GE provides this cheap black trim to put around the top and side, but the trim itself does absolutely no good. It's too thin to adequately conceal the gap between the appliance and the cabinet, and it's flimsy rubber, so it doesn't offer any stability when you are trying to line up the dishwasher with the cabinet.

Sentence (English): Got this KitchenAid Dishwasher about a week ago at Costco to replace a 10-year-old GE that was falling apart.
Comments (English): [ KitchenAid KDTS464SPS ] || ---------------- || Got this KitchenAid Dishwasher about a week ago at Costco to replace a 10-year-old GE that was falling apart. Decided to go with a higher end model this time around and I'm glad I did. This model has the ProDry Max drying feature which fans warm air and pops the door open at the end. Just like our autoclave at work! I was happy to see this feature is now available on dishwashers. The ProWash cycle with ProDry Max does take a long time to run, 3 hours and 49 minutes! While it was running it didn't make a lot of noise, so I opened the dishwasher mid-cycle to see what was going on. It was all steamy in there! I think the reason for the long cycle is to give the steam time to penetrate and break down the caked-on food. The dishwasher does a great job cleaning off caked-on food, so there is no need to pre-scrub the dishes and pots like before. I wonder if some of the less positive reviews on here are related to this particular cycle time. There is also a more traditional 90 minute Normal cycle, and a 70 minute Express cycle. These cycles are more like what you get in regular dishwashers that don't have the upgraded ProWash cycle with ProDry Max. The ProWash cycle with ProDry Max is going to give you cleaner, dryer dishes when you need them the next morning. After using it myself, I understand why everyone says a dishwasher is essential. In particular, since it is a 14-place setting model, I can load a large amount at once, so it is not a burden to run a full day's worth of dishes at once. Design: True to the Bespoke line, it is clean and blends well with the kitchen. Since it is a built-in unit, it fits perfectly without standing out, making the kitchen feel much more organized overall. I recommend this to: - Those who want to reduce dishwashing time. - Families with a large volume of dishes. - Those who desire both a clean kitchen interior and convenience. I hope my honest review has been helpful to everyone considering purchasing this product.

Comments (English): [ A kitchen revolution that captures both design and cleaning power ] || ---------------- || Honest Review of the Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher. Overall Evaluation and Rating. Rating: . One-line Summary: A kitchen revolution that captures both design and cleaning power. Background of Purchase: I ultimately chose Samsung Electronics’ BESPOKE model because it is easy to install and has proven performance. I wanted to escape the fatigue of daily dishwashing, secure leisurely evening time with my family, and simultaneously elevate the elegance of my kitchen interior. Key Features: 1. Countertop design that allows for direct installation above the sink without modifying the kitchen base cabinets. 2. BESPOKE’s signature stylish white color and minimal flat front design. 3. Hygienic finish free from grease and germ concerns through high-temperature direct water sterilization washing. Detailed Analysis of Advantages: 1. Space Utilization and Installation Convenience - It can be placed directly on the sink without removing the kitchen base cabinets, minimizing space constraints. Thanks to the professional on-site installation service, even the complex faucet connection was neatly finished. Although it has a 6-place setting capacity, the efficient internal design allows for ample storage of plates and cups after a meal, so I could really feel the convenience in my daily life. 2. Sophisticated Design with a Bespoke Vibe - The clean, uncluttered white color and flat front design create an interior effect that makes the entire kitchen look much brighter and more spacious, while standing out for its aesthetic perfection that harmoniously blends with any appliance. It acts not merely as a new appliance, but as a stylish object that elevates the kitchen's atmosphere, providing significant visual satisfaction every time you enter. Third. Powerful High-Temperature Sterilization Washing Performance - Using direct high-temperature water that is difficult to handle by hand, it thoroughly removes hardened grease and food residue. Furthermore, the sterilization wash function manages even invisible germs, allowing for safe use even in homes with children who have weak immune systems. Thanks to a feature that effectively expels internal moisture after washing, dishes remain fresh and dry, offering high reliability in terms of hygiene. Fourth. Low-Noise Design and Intuitive Convenience - Noise is managed quietly enough not to disturb living room activities even when operated late at night. Thanks to the intuitive control panel, anyone can easily select a cycle and check the progress without consulting a complex manual. Considering Samsung appliances' signature solid fundamentals and thorough after-sales service system, this product guarantees long-term satisfaction, so I would confidently recommend it to my friends and acquaintances. Areas for improvement? I found no areas requiring improvement. If this review was helpful in your product selection, please click the "Helpful" button.

Even though I measured the length, it was bigger than I expected. There was a bit of a gap due to the sink faucet handle, so I almost couldn't place the door near the sink, but the technician was very helpful and explained how to open the door carefully for use, which was great! Everyone, don't just think about the length of the main unit; make sure to consider the height at which the door opens! Since I live alone, I usually don't run it immediately after meals; instead, I let a few dishes sit for a while and use it about once a day. If you mainly put in cups, plates, and cutlery, space utilization is decent, but you just have to arrange them well. Because I put them in diagonally to avoid overlapping for fear of them not washing properly, not much fits inside. It lacks a hot air drying function, so drying takes time, but I probably wouldn't have used it even if it were available since it costs more in electricity. <Overall Impression>. Overall, it is a sufficiently satisfactory product for use as a dishwasher for 1-2 person households or newlyweds. It is most efficient when used in conjunction with some hand washing rather than completely replacing all dishwashing. I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): The biggest advantage is that it definitely reduces dishwashing time!
Comments (English): [ Highly recommended for 1-2 person households! ] || ---------------- || I looked into countertop dishwashers to reduce the time and energy spent on washing dishes, and I chose the 6-place setting model. There were many reviews stating that the capacity is sufficient for 1-2 person households, so I purchased it expecting to clean everyday dishes in one go. The design is clean and simple, so it blends well with any kitchen without standing out too much. Two professional technicians came, so I wasn't worried about damage during delivery. Even though I measured the length, it was bigger than I expected. There was a bit of a gap due to the sink faucet handle, so I almost couldn't place the door near the sink, but the technician was very helpful and explained how to open the door carefully for use, which was great! Everyone, don't just think about the length of the main unit; make sure to consider the height at which the door opens! Since I live alone, I usually don't run it immediately after meals; instead, I let a few dishes sit for a while and use it about once a day. I mainly use the standard or quick mode, and it feels like it sufficiently cleans everyday grease. However, frying pans or large pots are a bit awkward to fit in, so there are times when I end up washing them by hand as well. <Pros>. Running it just once a day noticeably reduces fatigue and makes daily life more comfortable. I also found it convenient in actual use that it performs basic drying after washing, allowing me to take items out and use them immediately. Since it is a countertop dishwasher, installation is simple, so being able to use it without major construction is another advantage. <Cons>. Even though it is rated for 6 people, the space is actually a bit lacking to comfortably fit large dishes. Pots and pans, in particular, are less useful, so it is difficult to completely replace them. The washing results vary depending on the arrangement of the dishes, so it takes some getting used to at first. If you mainly put in cups, plates, and cutlery, space utilization is decent, but you just have to arrange them well. Because I put them in diagonally to avoid overlapping for fear of them not washing properly, not much fits inside. It lacks a hot air drying function, so drying takes time, but I probably wouldn't have used it even if it were available since it costs more in electricity. <Overall Impression>. Overall, it is a sufficiently satisfactory product for use as a dishwasher for 1-2 person households or newlyweds. It is most efficient when used in conjunction with some hand washing rather than completely replacing all dishwashing. I highly recommend it.

The design is clean and simple, so it blends well with any kitchen without standing out too much. Two professional technicians came, so I wasn't worried about damage during delivery. Even though I measured the length, it was bigger than I expected. Everyone, don't just think about the length of the main unit; make sure to consider the height at which the door opens! Since I live alone, I usually don't run it immediately after meals; instead, I let a few dishes sit for a while and use it about once a day. I mainly use the standard or quick mode, and it feels like it sufficiently cleans everyday grease. If you mainly put in cups, plates, and cutlery, space utilization is decent, but you just have to arrange them well. Because I put them in diagonally to avoid overlapping for fear of them not washing properly, not much fits inside. It lacks a hot air drying function, so drying takes time, but I probably wouldn't have used it even if it were available since it costs more in electricity. <Overall Impression>. Overall, it is a sufficiently satisfactory product for use as a dishwasher for 1-2 person households or newlyweds. It is most efficient when used in conjunction with some hand washing rather than completely replacing all dishwashing. I highly recommend it.

It lacks a hot air drying function, so drying takes time, but I probably wouldn't have used it even if it were available since it costs more in electricity. <Overall Impression>. Overall, it is a sufficiently satisfactory product for use as a dishwasher for 1-2 person households or newlyweds. It is most efficient when used in conjunction with some hand washing rather than completely replacing all dishwashing. I highly recommend it.

Comments (English): [ Living up to expectations ] || ---------------- || Our last dishwasher was also a Bosch, installed over 15 years ago. I was shocked (though I obviously shouldn't have been) to see that the water and electrical hookups had moved completely, making the install much more complicated for me. On the other hand, the newer leveling procedure is much nicer. Of course, we're still just getting used to it, but I fully expect this new Benchmark version to last at least as long as the old "800" model did, and be just as easy to live with. (Full disclosure, the old one would still be running fine if "someone" hadn't taken a tumble on the open door! ) So far, my only quibble (and it's a large one) is that the Delay Start button has been moved to ONLY the app and is no longer on the control panel. At least let it be part of your Favorites settings! Our default has been to set a 2 hour delay when we start the dishwasher, but I doubt I'll be willing to use the app just to do that. I LOVE the new interior lighting!

Final Verdict Between the strong value from Costco, the outstanding installation by Jaime R., and the performance of the dishwasher itself, this has been one of the best appliance purchases I have made. Highly recommended.
